name: ewwon-android
description: Ewwon · app Android (Capacitor) que empacota o build web do servsul-connect

scripts.sync: npm run web:build && npx cap sync android && npm run android:prepare
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run web:build && npx cap add android && npm run assets && npm run sync
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:debug:win: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
